__comment.__description: This is a configuration file for FrameData. It contains settings and information about the project, including the project directory, tags, directories, and data groups.
__comment.projectDirectory: The path to the project directory. This should be set to the location where your project files are stored.

tagList.__description: A list of tags that are used to categorize and label different elements in the project. Each tag has a kind and a name.

__array.kind: The type of tag. This can be used to categorize tags based on their purpose or function.
__array.name: The name of the tag. This should be a unique identifier for the tag.

directoryList.__description: A list of directories that are part of the project. Each directory can be used to store different types of data or files related to the project.

__array.name: The name of the directory. This should be a unique identifier for the directory.
__array.tagList: A list of tags that are associated with this directory. This can be used to categorize the directory and its contents based on the tags.
__array.directoryList: A list of subdirectories that are contained within this directory. This can be used to create a hierarchical structure for organizing files and data within the project.

__comment.dataGroupList: A list of data groups that are used to organize related data together. Each data group can contain multiple data items that are related to each other.
